visual_action: A montage shows Donald Trump in various presidential settings: walking on a red carpet, emerging from doors, disembarking Air Force One, and at rallies. This is intercut with text overlays stating "PROMISES MADE PROMISES KEPT". A central segment features a rapid scroll of what appear to be user-submitted screenshots displaying low gas prices from many different US states, overlaid on footage of Trump speaking. The video concludes with more shots of Trump, including him dancing, and ends on a black and white image of the White House with the text "THE WHITE HOUSE".
